title: Persuasive Visualization: NYPD Misconduct and Promotions
description: A DSC 106 group project using ProPublica's NYPD civilian complaint data. We made charts arguing both for and against the claim that officers with more substantiated complaints are more likely to get promoted, then scored how deceptive each design choice was.

title: Expository Visualization: Grocery Store Foods
description: A DSC 106 project explaining patterns in a grocery store foods dataset through a single visualization.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site. Built from scratch with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for DSC 106, with a nav bar generated by JavaScript, a saved dark mode setting, and projects loaded from a JSON file.

title: Sauced.AI: Agentic Meal Prep Assistant
description: A hackathon prototype that uses the Gemini API and the Browser Use agent framework to scrape recipes, analyze nutrition, and rank recipes based on what you ask for in plain language.

title: Vision-Based Gesture Control System
description: A real-time hand gesture classifier built through ACM AI. I trained a ResNet18 model in PyTorch on 285K+ augmented images and used OpenCV to recognize 6 gestures live from a webcam.

title: Product Analytics at Elara
description: As a data analytics intern, I designed and set up a PostHog event tracking schema covering 25+ user events for a safety app before its launch.

title: Mental Health Court Outcomes Research
description: Research at UC San Diego's Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute. I merged and cleaned carceral datasets from several sources in Python and made visualizations showing disparities in mental health court outcomes.

title: The Fenty Effect: Inclusivity in Cosmetic Shade Ranges
description: An analysis of U.S. foundation products from 104 brands between 2016 and 2025, looking at whether shade ranges actually got more inclusive. Includes an interactive dashboard.

title: SAR Image Processing Pipelines
description: As an algorithm developer intern at Boundary Remote Subsurface Solutions, I wrote reusable Python pipelines for amplitude extraction, phase unwrapping, and lining up satellite radar images taken at different times.

title: Albuquerque Air Quality Analysis
description: A summer research project at the University of New Mexico. I processed hourly air quality data from several monitoring sites using Python and SQL and found that temperature drove a lot of the seasonal swings in pollution.

title: AI Adoption Among Community College Students
description: A survey of 500+ Irvine Valley College students about how they use AI tools. It won an Outstanding Research Poster Award, and I presented it at regional and national symposiums.

title: Visualization Critique
description: Placeholder for my DSC 106 Project 2.5, a short critique of a real-world visualization.
